title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
slides: Can AI data centers survive their own power hunger?
Global capacity is doubling roughly every eighteen months
But water cooling use is quietly sparking local backlash
Operators now face permitting delays in key regions
Map your region's power grid before committing
thread_text:
1. The AI Power Paradox

Data centers now consume as much electricity as some small nations, and operators are discovering that the grid can't keep up with their ambitions.

2. Doubling Every 18 Months

Global data center capacity is doubling roughly every eighteen months, far outpacing upgrades to power infrastructure in most regions.

3. Water Cooling Backlash

Local communities are pushing back against water-intensive cooling systems, creating unexpected friction in regions that once welcomed tech investment.

4. Permitting Delays Spread

Operators now face permitting delays in key regions, forcing project timelines to slip and costs to rise as regulators catch up.

5. Map Your Grid First

Before committing to a new AI project, check your region's power grid capacity. Have you done that yet?
